source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
Plant_UniId,
Plant_Cd,
Plant_NmCn,
Plant_NmEn,
Plant_Desc,
Plant_Type,
Plant_Type_Desc,
Company_Cd,
Plant_Addr,
Plant_Longitude,
Plant_Latitude,
City_Cd,
Country_Cd,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from
NESZ_DIM.DIM_NestlePlant
where Plant_Cd <> ''

select 
T1.PRD_UNIID,
T1.PRD_DES,
T1.PRD_DES_CN,
T1.PRD_CAG,
T1.PRD_CAG_DES,
T1.PRD_BRD_CD,
T1.PRD_BRD_DES,
T1.PRD_BRD_CN_DES,
T1.PRD_FAT_CS,
T1.PRD_GRP_CD,
T1.PRD_GRP_DES,
T1.PRD_GRP_DES PRD_GRP_DES2,
T1.PRD_NO,
T1.PRD_DES AS PRD_DES2,
T1.PRD_STG,
T1.PRD_GPS,
T1.PRD_TOL_LIF,
T1.PRD_TOL_PER,
CASE WHEN T1.PRD_MAU_UNACT_STA='Y' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END,
Case when T1.PRD_INA_FLG='Y' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END [1], 
T1.PRD_STA_DT,
T1.PRD_END_DT,
GETDATE() [2]
from [MVIEW].MDM_PRD_MST_MV T1

select PRD_UNIID,
       PRD_NO,
       PRD_SRC,
       PRD_TYP,
       PRD_TYP_DES,
       PRD_EAN_CS,
       PRD_EAN_EA,
       PRD_DES_CN,
       PRD_DES,
       PRD_OTH_DES,
       PRD_WGT,
       PRD_WGT_UNT,
       PRD_VOL,
       PRD_VOL_UNT,
       PRD_FAT_CS,
       PRD_TOL_LIF,
       PRD_TOL_PER,
       PRD_STG,
       PRD_STA_DT,
       PRD_END_DT,
       GETDATE()
from [MVIEW].MDM_PRD_MST_MV T1

SELECT
Supplier_UniId,
Supplier_Cd,
Supplier_NmCn,
Supplier_NmEn,
Location_UniId,
City_Cd,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
FROM 
NESZ_DIM.DIM_Supplier

select
Warehouse_UniId,
Warehouse_Cd,
Warehouse_NmCn,
Warehouse_NmEn,
Customer_UniId,
Location_UniId,
City_Cd,
Warehouse_Type_Cd,
Warehouse_Type_NmCn,
Warehouse_Type_NmEn,
Parent_Whs_Cd,
Parent_Whs_NmCn,
Parent_Whs_NmEn,
Warehouse_Status_Cd,
Warehouse_Status_Desc,
Warehouse_Src,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from 
NESZ_DIM.DIM_Warehouse
